description: GEMPACK is a software suite for building and solving economic models, especially computable general equilibrium (CGE) models, in which users write the model in an algebra-like notation and the software solves large systems of non-linear equations. It is developed at the Centre of Policy Studies (CoPS) at Victoria University in Melbourne, whose site notes a change of director after Mark Horridge's retirement. It is used for national, regional and global CGE models, including the widely used GTAP trade model and ORANI-type national models; the April 2025 update released GEMPACK 12.2.001 and RunDynam 3.91. Several versions are sold with different prices and capabilities, and a free trial version can be downloaded; data are held in HAR header array files that the HARPY Python tools can read. Caveats: licences are commercial, the full versions are Windows programs with separate Linux and Mac guidance, and prices are not shown on the page read. For simulation it runs economy-wide models that estimate how a disruption to industries, infrastructure or trade spreads through prices, output and employment, and supports resilience and capacity planning scenarios. It is related to the GTAP and input-output table records in this catalogue, which supply its data.
